pure-announcement.rationale: It is specification documentation of the CycloneDX object model, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: osv-format covers a different, vulnerability-only interchange format; a reader of that concept learns the entire CycloneDX object model fresh here.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every claim is verifiable against the published CycloneDX specification and the IANA media-type registry it links.

durability.rationale: The object model of an ECMA-standardized format — components, services, dependencies, compositions, formulation, declarations — plus IANA-registered media types and bom.json/*.cdx.json conventions is structural and changes slowly, not a version-pinned feature matrix.

actionability.rationale: It catalogs what the model can represent rather than guiding a decision; beyond a few integration facts (media types, file globs, the in-toto predicate type) it describes a landscape.

atomicity.rationale: It is one statable idea — CycloneDX's modular object model and its serialization surface — with the per-object sections as facets of that single schema.
